title: Welfare at Risk: Distributionally Robust Bounds for Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2512.20918v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a framework to study how the welfare effects of policy interventions are distributed across individuals when those effects are not directly observed. We bound the superquantile of individual welfare changes by the superquantile of conditional average welfare changes, which is typically identified, revealing how gains and losses are spread across the population. We also bound the share of the population whose welfare loss from the policy exceeds any given threshold --- a distribution-free counterpart to average cost--benefit analysis, closer to a poverty-rate measure of policy harm than to a mean welfare effect. translated_title: 福利面临风险：政策评估的分布鲁棒界
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个框架，用于研究当政策干预的福利效应无法被直接观测时，这些效应如何在个体之间分布。我们通过条件平均福利变化的超分位数（superquantile，通常可被识别）来为个体福利变化的超分位数设定界限，从而揭示收益与损失如何在人群中得到分布。我们还为福利损失超过任一给定阈值的人口比例设定界限——这是平均成本收益分析的无分布对应物，与平均福利效应相比，它更接近于以贫困率方式衡量政策损害。我们进一步将这两个界限扩展到允许分析者对可观测特征分布的认知存在模糊性（ambiguity）的情形：在某一总体上估计的非鲁棒界限，在应用于另一目标总体时可能系统性地过于乐观，而鲁棒版本凭借其对模糊性的处理（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个分布鲁棒的政策评估框架，通过可识别的条件平均福利变化的超分位数来界定个体福利变化的超分位数和遭受政策损失超过任意阈值的人口比例，并进一步允许对可观测特征分布的认知存在模糊性，从而稳健地刻画政策干预收益与损失在人群中的分布。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a distributionally robust framework for policy evaluation that bounds the superquantile of individual welfare changes and the share of the population suffering losses beyond any threshold via identified conditional average welfare changes, further accommodating ambiguity in the distribution of observable characteristics to avoid systematically overoptimistic evaluations across populations.
